responsibility: Implements the affine-expression utility layer used by GCC loop and data-reference optimizers to turn tree expressions and addresses into bounded affine combinations of SSA names plus constants. It owns construction, simplification, scaling, addition, type conversion, recursive SSA expansion caches, constant-multiple and non-overlap tests, debug printing, and helpers such as get_inner_reference_aff that decompose memory references into affine base-plus-offset form consumed by dependence analysis, loop transforms, and address reasoning.
same_name_distinction: Implements the affine-expression operations declared in gcc/tree-affine.h: it contains the executable arithmetic, SSA-expansion/cache handling, address decomposition via get_inner_reference_aff, overlap testing, and debug printing, whereas the header only defines the aff_tree representation and public interfaces.
